en: Grunt
There you are! The boss wants you back. We could use a pair of hands for the old work, you know the kind.
Former Member
I told you before. That life is over for me. Taking Pokémon from people hurt everyone, me included.
Grunt
And what has quitting got you? Folk still look at you like a crook! Stick with us and they'll be the ones looking up!
Former Member
No. Lord N trusted us to be kind to Pokémon. I won't let him down again.
Grunt
Lord N, Lord N! He walked out on the lot of us. Some king he turned out to be!
{rival}
Hey!
Team Plasma! Where are the Pokémon you've taken? Answer me!
Grunt
You again?! Not today, kid. I've got orders to keep my head down. Next time, though!
{rival}
You're not getting away!
Former Member
I'm all right. Thank you for standing by me.
He and I joined Team Plasma on the same day. Then, two years back, the team broke in two.
Those of us who stayed loyal to Lord N only care for Pokémon now. The others answer to Ghetsis, and he has bigger plans.
There is more to tell, if you want to hear it. We live in the old church up on the hill, next to the Gym.
Former Member
Please, it's nothing to do with you. He'll leave soon enough... I hope.
Rood
This is the home of those who have left Team Plasma behind. We keep to ourselves, traveller. Good day to you.
Rood
So you are the Trainer who stood up for one of our own on the bridge. You are interested in Team Plasma, then?
Before I ask you in, I would see what kind of person you are. In a Pokémon battle, if you will.
Will you battle me?
Then let us begin.
Well battled. Please forgive the test. People are wary of us, and so we are wary of them in turn.
{rival}
{player}! He got away from me... Huh? Who's this?
Rood
Your friend? Then he may come in too. Please, both of you, follow me.
Then I am afraid I must ask you to leave. Come back if you change your mind.
Worker
Sorry, the boss is in the middle of something right now. Come back a bit later, would you?
{rival}
{player}! You got your Badge too? I knew you would!
I couldn't have done it without my team. A Badge is great, but what matters is how we got it together.
That's what Team Plasma never understood. A Pokémon isn't a prize to grab. Ask my sister's Purrloin!
Clay
Huh! So you two know each other. Good pair of young'uns, the both of ya. Got somethin' worth showin' ya.
{rival}
Hang on, Clay. I heard you gave Team Plasma a place to live, right here in your city. Why would you do that?
Clay
A man can dig himself out of any hole, given a shovel and time. Those folks put the shovel to work, so I gave 'em time.
Judge a fella only by what you think's right, and one day there'll be nobody left you can stand to listen to.
{rival}
...Sounds like a grown-up excuse to me. Fine! You do your thing. I'm still going after Team Plasma!
So what did you want to show us?
Clay
South of town there's the Pokémon World Tournament. Gym Leaders, Champions, the best from every region battle there!
Come on down when you're ready. I'll be there.
{rival}
The best from every region? Then I've got some training to do. See you there, {player}!
Clay
The Pokémon World Tournament's south of town. Don't keep me waitin'!
